verdict.rationale: Whether a cloud platform's software is source-available under an open license is a fair openness question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows CoreWeave publishing any source code under an open license. The Terraform provider, generated API clients, and docs (including llms.txt) are mentioned without any license or source-repository information, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
